description: Read an invoice someone sent you through its Last Price pay link, the way an accounts-payable agent would: pass invoice, the pay link (the page or JSON address) or the 43-character token in it. It answers the amount due, currency, due date, invoice number, seller, status and each accepted payment method with how to use it (x402 in USDC to the seller's own wallet, or a card checkout). Paying is a separate step, at the pay or checkout address each method gives, after the person you work for approves it. Answers 404 for an unknown link or one whose seller has not switched pay links on. Public: needs no credential.

invoice.description: The pay link (https://last-price.ai/invoice/... or https://api.last-price.ai/api/public/invoices/...) or its 43-character token.

name: read_payable_invoice
